_provenance: Hand-maintained by the site maintainer. Every entry links to a public record; dates are UTC; times are given where a public timestamp exists.

events.title: Independent audit completed
events.simple: A separate reviewer re-checked every number in the first version of the test kit, v0.1.0, before it was published and found no wrong value.
events.technical: Audit of the corpus at commit 4db7d2a, v0.1.0, before publication; 65,887 field-level comparisons agreed with the frozen expected values; documentation findings and their resolutions are recorded in AUDIT.md. The writer-side case of v0.2.0 and the fixes of v0.2.1 have not been separately audited.

events.title: Alpha-5 encoding verified against Space-Track
events.simple: The maintainer checked the lettered catalog numbers against the official catalog using their own account; nothing from that catalog is published.
events.technical: Maintainer's run of tools/verify_against_spacetrack.py: 44 records, letters A and T, zero encoding defects; only verdicts were recorded and no Space-Track data entered the corpus.

events.title: Corpus v0.1.0 published
events.simple: The first public version of the test kit went online.
events.technical: Release v0.1.0 of gp-omm-conformance (tag on commit fdf4043): 16 cases, frozen expected values, vectors, derived files, runner.

events.title: Zenodo DOI minted
events.simple: The test kit received a permanent citation number.
events.technical: Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22867654 (all versions) and version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22867655 (v0.1.0); recorded in CITATION.cff.

events.title: Issue #171 filed upstream
events.simple: A bug found by the test kit was reported to the python-sgp4 library.
events.technical: brandon-rhodes/python-sgp4#171: an empty OBJECT_ID element in OMM XML makes sgp4.omm.initialize raise TypeError; reproducer on CCSDS example values.

events.title: Pull request #172 opened
events.simple: A fix for that bug was submitted to the library for review.
events.technical: brandon-rhodes/python-sgp4#172 from hneogy:omm-empty-object-id, one commit, two files, two tests; 47 upstream tests pass on both builds.

events.title: SatNOGS: support above 99,999 in progress
events.simple: Fredy, a maintainer of SatNOGS, the open ground-station network, said none of its parts handle the new numbers yet and that support is in progress.
events.technical: Fredy, SatNOGS maintainer, replying on the Libre Space forum to the corpus announcement: no SatNOGS component supports NORAD ids above 99999; Alpha-5 and OMM JSON support said to be in progress, level differing by sub-project. Standing state is kept on the library page's ecosystem list.

events.title: Corpus v0.2.0 published
events.simple: A new version of the test kit adds a check for programs that write the old format, not only read it, and a command that checks a file such a program wrote.
events.technical: Release v0.2.0 of gp-omm-conformance (tag on commit b54c3b8): 17 cases; adds the writer-side case tle-writer-alpha5 (does a tool that writes a TLE put a correct Alpha-5 catalog field on both lines, and does it refuse ids the field cannot represent) and the gpconf check-tle command for files a tool wrote; the sixteen v0.1.0 cases and their expected values are unchanged.

events.title: Zenodo DOI minted
events.simple: The new version of the test kit received its own permanent citation number.
events.technical: Version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22906966 (v0.2.0) under the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22867654; recorded in CITATION.cff.

events.title: Corpus v0.2.1 published
events.simple: A maintenance version fixes places where the test kit had reported a pass it had not actually checked; the seventeen tests are unchanged, and one new check was added for programs that write the old format.
events.technical: Release v0.2.1 of gp-omm-conformance (tag on commit b1407a5): fixes to cases where the corpus reported a pass it had not checked (DECISIONS D-111 to D-115 and D-117 to D-119); the seventeen cases and their frozen expected values are unchanged; one writer check added (tle-writer-column-layout); naive and python-sgp4 results unchanged at 14 and 7 of 17 cases failing.

events.title: Zenodo DOI minted
events.simple: The maintenance version of the test kit received its own permanent citation number.
events.technical: Version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22926017 (v0.2.1) under the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22867654; recorded in CITATION.cff.
